contexts.text: Scarcely had they lain down () = the first time of visitation, Explained.
To lie with = to be conjoined.
To lie with = to be perverted or adulterated. AC 3399.
(Jacob) lay down in that place () = tranquillity of state; for to lie down = to be in a state of tranquillity; because a lying down and sleeping is nothing else.
That to lie down, in the Word, = a state of tranquillity. Illustrated.
Upon which thou liest () = in which he was.
Three... flocks lying near it (). (Explained.)
He lay with her in that night () = conjunction.
To lie with her () = to be conjoined illegitimately. AC 4445.
To lie with () = to profane.
Lie with me () = that it desired conjunction.
He listened not to her to lie with her () = that it was averse to be conjoined... To lie with her = to be conjoined illegitimately. AC 5015.
I will lie with my fathers () = life such as there was with the Ancients. To lie = life; for to lie, here, means to be buried with them, (which) = resurrection and regeneration...
lie couched as a lion ()... To couch = to lie in safety and without fear.
Lying between burdens () = life among works. To lie = life, but obscuro life. AE 445:4.
And shall lie with her () = illegitimate conjunction.
Everyone lying with a beast () = conjunction with the evils of the cupidities of the love of self.
To lie under a burden () = to perish.
They appeared to be lying down when they were deliberating.
They went to bed.
To lie down securely, none making afraid (). Explained.
The odour of boiled prunes corresponds to the delight married partners have in lying beside each other... in simply lying beside her.
To couch () = that he is in security from all falsity and evil.
To lie among the orders () = to live in the statutes.
In peace together I lie down and sleep ()... To lie down and to sleep = to live.
They shall lie down securely () = protection in the Church from the breaking in of falsity...
